title: Light Italian Cheese Tiramisu
description: A yeasty and cheesy Italian dessert featuring mint and a cheese pull, made with a high protein friendly recipe and deep fried ladyfingers, formed into a tiramisu shape.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees.
Deep fry the ladyfingers for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the mascarpone cheese, ricotta cheese, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the egg mixture to the cheese mixture and mix until smooth.
Stir in the chopped mint leaves.
Dip the deep fried ladyfingers into the cheese mixture and layer in a large serving dish.
Sprinkle the cocoa powder on top of the ladyfingers.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.
